name: mainbook
description: Convert PDF bank statements to reviewed JSON, XLSX, or CSV through MainBook.

tools.name: convert_bank_statement
tools.description: Convert one PDF bank statement through the complete MainBook workflow. JSON stays inline; local XLSX/CSV results are written to an allowed folder and returned as a full path. This creates a job and spends page credits.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Return total, reserved, and available MainBook credits. Every value is measured in PDF pages.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: List one cursor page of conversion jobs visible to the MainBook account. Pass the returned next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Get a conversion after a timeout. JSON stays inline; local XLSX/CSV results are written to an allowed folder. HTTP mode returns safe download instructions.

tools.name: output_folder
tools.description: Read or change the default local result folder. Pass an allowed absolute folder, or next_to_source to restore the default behavior.

api_key.title: MainBook API key
api_key.description: Create one at mainbook.ai/developer. It starts with mb_live_.

allowed_directories.title: Folders MainBook may read and write
allowed_directories.description: MainBook only reads source PDFs and writes result files inside these folders. Add folders where you keep statements or exports.
